items.label: GAMES 2026 YTD
items.definition: Games recorded from 1 January to 17 Nov 2026, against the same dates in 2025.

items.label: BLUE SIDE WIN 2026
items.definition: Share of 2026 games won by the blue side; change against 2025.

items.label: AVG GAME 2026
items.definition: Mean game length in 2026; change in seconds against 2025.

items.label: KILLS / GAME 2026
items.definition: Mean total kills per game (both teams) in 2026; change against 2025.

items.label: UPSET RATE 2026
items.definition: Share of 2026 games won by the team with the lower pre-game Elo win probability.

items.label: ELO #1
items.definition: Highest current Elo among active teams from internationally linked leagues.

items.label: WORLDS 2026 FINAL
items.definition: Latest World Championship series in the data (series approximated).

items.label: MODEL ACCURACY
items.definition: Logistic regression, share of test-period games with the winner predicted correctly.

items.label: MODEL BRIER
items.definition: Logistic regression Brier score on the test period, against the blue-side-rate baseline (lower is better).

data.note: Computed from the loaded archive. Year-on-year changes compare full calendar years, except game counts, which compare the same dates.
